# Shortlist: companies to build custom AI agents for a US enterprise

For a US enterprise investing in custom AI agents, I’d evaluate a mix of **enterprise AI platforms, cloud providers, and specialist implementation firms**\. The right choice depends on whether you want to build agents in-house, integrate them into existing enterprise systems, or hire a partner to deliver production-ready agents.

I’d assess each company on five criteria: enterprise security and governance, integration with existing systems, ability to handle multi-step workflows, human approval and auditability, and the cost of operating agents at scale.

## 1\. Recommended shortlist

The companies below are a mix of implementation partners and platforms you can use to build agents. They are not all direct substitutes, so I’ve grouped them by the job they are best suited to do.

![Accenture's Manisha Bhattacharya on building careers, changing lives, and empowering the underprivileged  | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Wv8zdx16GU2_6NLbG7a5tDeanor9otRNUwxjiv-ddmuxJ_5QngkQqCPiFjKd89uhvXhnltBU2j4LEyWHTBsokjaGk8auBFmSemNxt7jsGnLfXy4_A700_c--BoFz_6kBMbAoqvorDyqMg98yiz7hTtHGJFfHMBEsBYbh_GE_dTBmgDgyHlh7AUOlWKvPoLDM?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Accenture**

(Best for large-scale transformation)

Best when you need agents deployed across multiple business units, geographies, and legacy systems. Accenture is worth considering for enterprise-wide workflow redesign, systems integration, industry-specific solutions, and organizational change management.

**Why shortlist it\:** Strong fit for complex programs involving SAP, Oracle, cloud platforms, and multiple stakeholders.

Trade-off: potentially substantial consulting costs and program overhead.

[Official website](https://www.accenture.com/)

---

![IBM Hrvatska d.o.o.- AmCham Croatia](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E_it3ZPJayo5XzWrgf5Z9tD_YWLTDeFq5BIZCPZCbAasAfvm41rkC6v_t69wbpuXbPmMhrZivJLMHkH-88Bzo478a1dg0VTrj8T9PlNlcgFst0AFMtCewI79yn0CSMELcLaE_mZfwy3LBDjSZ46gATfiFA6HMb0-KXGupC2v9nnH4c0c8VOP_SteoEGWGFL-?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. IBM Consulting**

(Best for governance and hybrid environments)

A strong candidate for enterprises with sensitive data, complex access controls, legacy infrastructure, or a need to coordinate AI across multiple technology vendors.

**Why shortlist it\:** Combines enterprise consulting with IBM's watsonx ecosystem and experience in hybrid-cloud and regulated environments.

Trade-off: validate the proposed architecture against your preferred cloud and avoid unnecessary platform lock-in.

[Official website](https://www.ibm.com/consulting)

---

![Deloitte Jobs - 24 offerte di lavoro - talendo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hG4n0AcZB0o-wgxHA2xQy4bXyTUc4N6j-O1bqz5aGBbPmVwYOu8yHtXC1YbJyszi9HIFP-MJi3uKRa1KRhTGJhBvUAVL05Fryw6hzj-rfX9XzcZdLAqXY4dHn1m5YadmqPiTnVbrGwyinTWQLO7AUAjISUlLf69V-obvsnDCra4Pz9HfAeTmUaj6GQrU9b3P?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Deloitte**

(Best for regulated or high-stakes workflows)

Consider Deloitte for agents used in financial operations, risk management, compliance, insurance, or other workflows where controls and auditability matter as much as automation.

**Why shortlist it\:** Can combine business-process expertise, risk and control design, and technical implementation.

Trade-off: make sure the engagement includes hands-on engineering and production ownership, not just strategy.

[Official website](https://www.deloitte.com/)

---

![EPAM System - The MarTech Summit Sponsor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/O309nAzfYbK5sdB1mxsWwMne8-HulHaP2lQkNquSOsjM5Sl062p87v1fXobBDHTradd8SSPO9tiXJYay96n9RgxM357ue3DRx4XU9mvHJWLIIanTd_nfIdQJz7tfPjd-arMQk0XeshKT4NMgDqg8-tXzZ_2pBAmyK7bqePx0XtmqSNhzA-tzlyp2qUEtjyHK?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. EPAM Systems**

(Best for deeply customized agents)

A good candidate when the agent is effectively a new software product: it must use proprietary APIs, orchestrate several systems, follow complex business logic, or be embedded in an existing application.

**Why shortlist it\:** Engineering-led product development is particularly relevant when customization, reliability, and integration are more important than deploying a standard packaged assistant.

Trade-off: define ownership of source code, evaluation infrastructure, and ongoing maintenance in the contract.

[Official website](https://www.epam.com/)

---

![Slalom Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/V_NXxKbmtHJakWO1na9QZR_bpXYcMVWMcE1WItH-4jsa213WwPHfye2_bC1FRII7Am4x9NQLpBQcofoWrbmw-thhJG66SJu8KD-5Eh1wRzW4lxDjM5DRD3eLqT0QsZHqwt97guSZNM_c2JQOEXVNQOHlhiBWUaBL2-Q8fgGnCSgBCa-9ooGRKoHbt_TvoMDz?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Slalom**

(Best for hands-on delivery)

Worth considering if you want a consulting partner to work closely with your internal team on a bounded agent use case, integrate with your cloud environment, and help get it adopted by employees.

**Why shortlist it\:** A useful middle ground between a large global transformation consultancy and a smaller specialist engineering shop.

Trade-off: verify the specific team's production-agent experience and availability before selecting it.

[Official website](https://www.slalom.com/)

---

![Chutes | Breakthrough Serverless AI Compute](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/a6ThlGATatKymTTqG99iXjnJDx5xU0jorTI_3GIpb-2Q3FR1XJXtcosG3VbFoT5vvqSv8rDT3bkKRmrWbVRCPKwGWqBHUlYNXb6TMqkeqxYqIn1iXMABJ2PhRL-txKfyyqX5RX3UMbmWO5zU38wHm-koyqslRauUFoR6LTNzWHpqQIAZgUoq2F39VjE7VKi1?purpose=fullsize)

**6\. Microsoft**

(Best for Microsoft-centric enterprises)

Consider Microsoft when employees work primarily in Microsoft 365, Teams, Dynamics, and Azure. Copilot Studio supports custom agents that use enterprise knowledge, connectors, APIs, workflows, and other agents. [learn.microsoft.com](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-overview?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** Existing identity, collaboration, and business-system integration can simplify deployment and administration.

Trade-off: assess licensing, consumption costs, connector limitations, and how much custom code your use case needs.

[Agent platform documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-overview)

---

![AI Identity Summit Paris](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/kbmmvLFTdYm1pdo1rsMw8YgDzbu3VNpgjSKlqw67dBP9rjNGVE90my8yB9xSNwlCKZzMQeEgBw5-PMY971eB5zlM-m_hJYcFCcMUOXxfy8wYGdutB9k9HtSMGl2k-BV_Ie6wkFRZH4_PkXXb156iuAK_8i6ez6IZCaloq3HwcYROhpvl-9Hl-ZG8iaOin3rX?purpose=fullsize)

**7\. Amazon Web Services (AWS)**

(Best for cloud-native custom agents)

A strong option if your workloads and data already live on AWS, or you want engineering teams to build agents directly into your applications and operational systems.

**Why shortlist it\:** Amazon Bedrock provides model access and agent capabilities, while Bedrock AgentCore supports deploying and operating agents using different models and frameworks. [aws.amazon.com](https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agents/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Trade-off: you'll need engineering expertise to design the agent architecture, integrations, evaluation, and operational controls.

[AWS agent services](https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agents/)

---

![Parceiros de Cloud | Contacta](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZqdiJfY4xiSmn1XmnoaQhJff5dG-Jq4Wy0Y6JUpNAaWwN3YY1bVyrcXCCYPQck27-W1fDKs4zU8T5iXZIt5L6wfRBd4Z4FQJqHgtEYIOfrV7OAJaTofLf-Yu-0WxEEVL3FQH44e_4nuZmeWlAqQIoQL2devV-58q1b6g6H_drGTTJ4pj0p5RWbpI9F24BgXp?purpose=fullsize)

**8\. Google Cloud**

Best if you need a flexible agent platform connected to enterprise data, analytics, and multiple model families.

**Why shortlist it\:** Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform provides low-code and code-based development, model choice, agent deployment, evaluation, identity, and governance features. [docs.cloud.google.com](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/overview?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Trade-off: compare operational maturity and integration requirements against your existing cloud estate.

[Agent platform documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/overview)

---

![Salesforce - AI Tool Review | LinkGo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/I_Jsun259NxXgspjAS9ba6hv5D2HjnKRV8zmWfkaJs1inE2ektYtWv6Q1ehQn0NvyXjoW_r9mV3pUW-CZ7xQqGIJlnMb5KGJeVEgigEBon4VrfOMELAjPuQfOtponMZn7MJHD0ImybVqQXdOwFGfkIqNccyeKfo8ofqUJ61Jup2JtwRfreZl5APCQGHFj0ny?purpose=fullsize)

**9\. Salesforce**

Best for customer-facing agents and sales, service, and CRM workflows.

**Why shortlist it\:** Agentforce combines agent building, Salesforce business context, workflow automation, integrations through MuleSoft, and monitoring. [www.salesforce.com](https://www.salesforce.com/platform/agentforce-platform/?bc=OTH&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Trade-off: strongest when the workflows are close to Salesforce; assess costs and flexibility for broader cross-enterprise use cases.

[Agentforce platform](https://www.salesforce.com/platform/agentforce-platform/)

## 2\. Which three would I start with?

For a typical large US enterprise seeking genuinely custom agents, rather than just chatbots, I'd start with these three partner conversations\:

| Priority | Company | Initial use case |
|--------|--------|--------|
| 1 | EPAM Systems | A bespoke agent requiring complex integrations and custom engineering |
| 2 | Accenture | A multi-department rollout involving major enterprise systems and process change |
| 3 | Slalom | A focused pilot that needs close collaboration with internal engineering and business teams |


Then add the platform provider that best matches your existing stack: Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, or Salesforce. IBM Consulting and Deloitte deserve early consideration if governance, regulation, or legacy infrastructure are dominant concerns.

This is a **fit-based shortlist, not a ranking of objectively superior vendors**\. The implementation partners should be evaluated on named delivery teams and references, not brand reputation alone.

## 3\. What to ask during vendor selection

Use the same questions with every finalist\:

- **Production proof\:** Can you demonstrate an agent running in production with measurable business results?
- **Integration\:** Can it securely read and write to our ERP, CRM, document repositories, and internal APIs?
- **Reliability\:** How do you test multi-step decisions, tool failures, hallucinations, and edge cases?
- **Control\:** Can we enforce least-privilege access, approval gates, audit logs, and human escalation?
- **Ownership\:** Do we own the code, prompts, evaluation tests, and deployment configuration?
- **Economics\:** What are the total build and run costs at our expected transaction volume?
- **Exit strategy\:** Can we switch models or providers without rebuilding the entire solution?

I would ask each finalist to propose a paid pilot with a baseline, a defined business outcome, security requirements, and explicit production acceptance criteria.

## 4\. One question that would narrow this down considerably

What kind of custom AI agents are you looking to build?

Primary use case

Customer service, sales, or contact center

Internal knowledge and employee productivity

Cross-functional workflows across ERP, CRM, finance, or operations

Software engineering, IT, or cybersecurity

Industry-specific or regulated workflows

---

Preferred delivery model

Hire a company to design and build the agents

Build internally using an AI platform or framework

Partner builds the first version; our team operates and extends it

---

Organization size

Mid-market

Large enterprise / Fortune 500

Regulated enterprise or government contractor

[Refine shortlist]
